name: Momoiro Memory Azu
source:
A realistic love simulation game that tells the story of becoming good friends with a girl through your activities at school all the way until graduation, featuring an overwhelming amount of over 700 events and 300 character patterns.

After progressing to his final year at school, our protagonist spent his time enjoying school life, playing games, talking to girls on the phone, going on dates and every now and then studying together with them until graduation.

Through various experiences, such as his schoolwork and playing sports, club activities and part-time jobs, our protagonist grows and matures. And then, he meets the girl he is destined to be with for all eternity, and swears his undying love for her. Decide his fate whether it's eternal life or a darker future that awaits him. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url] and [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ010683.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款写实恋爱模拟游戏，讲述通过校园活动与女孩成为好友，一直到毕业的故事。游戏包含超过700个事件和300种角色模式，数量惊人。

进入学校最后一年后，主角享受校园生活：玩游戏、和女孩打电话、约会，偶尔一起学习直到毕业。

通过课业、运动、社团活动和兼职等各种经历，主角成长成熟。随后，他遇见命中注定相伴永远的女孩，向她发誓永恒的爱。决定他的命运：是永生，还是等待着黑暗未来。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]VNDB Review[/url]及[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ010683.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
